name: Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata -blessing flowers-
original_name: 冴えない彼女の育てかた -blessing flowers-
source:
Adapted from light novel written by Maruto Fumiaki and art by Misaki Kurehito, Aki Tomoya is a male otaku who works part-time to earn money to buy anime. One day during spring vacation, he meets a beautiful girl. A month later, he finds out that the girl is his classmate, Megumi, who is hardly noticed by the other classmates. Tomoya, who also has no special skills or abilities, goes to Sawamura Spencer Eriri, a well-known member of the Art Club, to provide the art for a game the club is developing, and to Kasumigoaka Utaha to write the game scenario. The three subsequently form Blessing Software, which they plan to sell at the next Comiket.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saekano:_How_to_Raise_a_Boring_Girlfriend]Wikipedia[/url]]
